item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01510","case1_error":"Uses one bottle’s 80-load capacity as the total capacity of two bottles, instead of 160 loads.","case2_error":"Adds the lightsaber’s cost again after already including it in the $3000 total.","reason":"The first fails to scale capacity by bottle count; the second double-counts an already included purchase.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01511","case1_error":"Mislabels salary minus necessities as expenses and ignores the stated $18 remainder, reporting the pre-tax balance as taxes.","case2_error":"Counts only three diners, omitting Bret from Bret plus three coworkers.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect balance relation and omits leftover money; the second undercounts people when calculating meal costs.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01512","case1_error":"Subtracts leaked filling time from normal filling time, reversing the requested increase and deriving −24 minutes despite correct closing prose.","case2_error":"Equates one-sixth of a day with 24 hours, omitting the fractional scaling; it should be four hours.","reason":"The first reverses the subtraction defining an increase; the second incorrectly converts a fractional day into hours.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01513","case1_error":"Correctly sets up 35 × 2/7 but incorrectly evaluates the multiplication as 9.5 instead of 10.","case2_error":"Treats the one-cent payment per page as payment per book, yielding a page count labeled as books.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly formulated expression; the second uses a per-page rate as a per-book rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01514","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written sum 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written sum 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"Both make numerical evaluation errors in correctly formulated sums.","judgment":"same"}]}
